summary: La Paz, Quito, Bogotá and Mexico City come fast, Addis Ababa and Nairobi with thought; Bolivia's second capital Sucre at #3 is the surprise, Kabul (#11, 5 m short of Nairobi) the near miss, Kathmandu and Tehran (#18) the traps.
reasons: Builder's own replays, pending a real judge (the builder knew the answers when writing them). A casual order found 7 (6 without Sucre) and lost its lives on Kathmandu, Lima, Kabul, Tehran and Caracas; Denver and Lhasa were free.

The capitals of the UN's 193 members and its observers, a row per capital (197): Bolivia's La Paz and Sucre both rank. Capitals at sea level (Singapore, Tunis, 0 m) and below it (Amsterdam, Baku) rank too. Taipei, Pristina and territories' capitals are free, as are non-capital cities.
Countries are free ('bolivia' is no capital), as on capitals. Mexico City is the one overlap with capitals (by population). Blitz not simulated.
